description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Notifying that the Legal Rate of Interest determined by the Monetary Board shall be 7.06% per annum w.e.f. 01.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the determination of the Legal Rate of Interest by the Monetary Board under Section 192 of the Civil Procedure Code. It involves a regulatory matter concerning legal interest rates, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it pertains to statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
